name: hiran-skills
description: Professional CV tailoring skill for Product/Data roles. Rewrites profiles, skills, and bullets to match job descriptions using semantic keyword matching and ATS scoring. Generates DOCX + PDF output with professional formatting.
author: Hiran Patel (hiranmanu)

skills.name: CV Tailoring
skills.description: Tailors your CV to a job description using a 9-phase workflow. Rewrites profile and skills to match JD keywords, generates professional DOCX + PDF output, and logs applications to a tracker workbook.

examples.title: Tailor CV to Product Director Role
examples.description: Paste a Product Director job description and get a tailored CV with search/discovery/recommendations front-loaded and proper ATS keyword coverage.
examples.usage: Quick mode: 1-2 min. Full manual: 90-135 min.

examples.title: Generate ATS Score Report
examples.description: Get before/after ATS keyword coverage scores to understand which JD keywords your CV is missing.

workflowModes.name: Quick
workflowModes.description: Paste JD → generate PDF → done. No questions, no review.

workflowModes.name: Balanced
workflowModes.description: Paste JD → 2-3 quick questions → generate → review → upload.

workflowModes.name: Full Manual
workflowModes.description: All 9 phases: research → gaps → scoring → tailoring → generation → validation → QA → logging → upload.
